verdict.rationale: Unified build, deploy, and runtime logs is a fair question for a hosting and deploy platform like Netlify, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item mentions logs of any kind. The closest item, netlify-docs-17, covers tracking performance and team and visitor behavior, which is analytics rather than a unified log view.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view all my build, deploy, and runtime logs in one place
